gloss: to shatter; to smash to pieces; to be broken into fragments

definitions.gloss: to shatter; to smash to pieces; to be broken into fragments
definitions.explanation: to shatter; to smash to pieces; to be broken into fragments

definitions.gloss: to be shattered; to be completely destroyed (hopes, dreams, confidence)
definitions.explanation: to be shattered; to be completely destroyed (hopes, dreams, confidence)

examples.japanese: ⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{粉々|こなごな}になった。

examples.english: I dropped the vase on the floor and it shattered into pieces.

notes:
Describes something breaking into many small pieces or fragments. The word ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧ (from ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧, powder) emphasizes that the breaking is thorough and complete. Used both literally for physical objects and figuratively for abstract things like dreams and trust.

USAGE:
- {粉々|こなごな}になる: to shatter (intransitive)
- ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to smash to pieces (transitive)
- ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{砕|くだ}ける→砕ける：04667_kudakeru⟧ / ⟦{砕|くだ}く→砕く：03920_kudaku⟧: to crush to pieces

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧: to break into pieces
- ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{砕|くだ}く→砕く：03920_kudaku⟧: to crush into fragments
- ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧: to smash to pieces

SIMILAR WORDS:
- バラバラ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to fall apart; to come to pieces — implies separating into distinct pieces, while ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧ suggests finer, more complete destruction
- ⟦{砕|くだ}ける→砕ける：04667_kudakeru⟧: to break; to be crushed — the act of breaking apart, while ⟦{粉々|こなごな}→粉々：18766_konagona⟧ describes the resulting state of being in fragments
